meaning: to win or earn (respect, trust, a prize)

senses.en: to win or earn (respect, trust, a prize)

note: Objects are abstract: 赢得信任/尊重/比赛. For "win a game" people also say 赢了.

examples.zh: 他的努力赢得了大家的信任。
examples.en: His hard work won everyone's trust.

examples.zh: 这家公司是怎么赢得客人信任的？
examples.en: How did this company earn its customers' trust?

examples.zh: 我们赢得了比赛，大家都很高兴。
examples.en: We won the match, and everyone was happy.

meaning: excited, thrilled

senses.en: excited, thrilled

note: 兴奋 is high-energy excitement; 激动 is more emotionally moved.

examples.zh: 明天要去旅游，孩子都很兴奋。
examples.en: We go on a trip tomorrow, and the kids are all excited.

examples.zh: 你怎么这么兴奋？有什么好消息吗？
examples.en: Why are you so excited? Any good news?

examples.zh: 别太兴奋，晚上你还要早睡。
examples.en: Don't get too excited; you still need to sleep early tonight.

meaning: garbage, trash, rubbish

senses.en: garbage, trash, rubbish

note: 垃圾桶 = trash can; 扔垃圾 = throw out trash; also used for "junk" (垃圾邮件 = spam).

examples.zh: 出门的时候，请把垃圾带下去。
examples.en: When you go out, please take the trash down.

examples.zh: 这里不能乱放垃圾。
examples.en: You can't leave trash lying around here.

examples.zh: 我的邮箱里全是垃圾邮件。
examples.en: My inbox is full of spam.

meaning: uncle (father's younger brother); also a polite term for a man

senses.en: uncle (father's younger brother); also a polite term for a man

note: Kids also call any man of their parents' age 叔叔.

examples.zh: 我叔叔在上海工作，周末会来看我们。
examples.en: My uncle works in Shanghai and will visit us at the weekend.

examples.zh: 小朋友，快跟叔叔说谢谢。
examples.en: Little one, say thank you to the uncle quickly.

examples.zh: 你叔叔今年多大了？
examples.en: How old is your uncle this year?

meaning: to stop (what one is doing); to pull up

senses.en: to stop (what one is doing); to pull up

note: 停 + 下 (resultative): stop the action. 停下来 is also common.

examples.zh: 车停下以后，大家才开始下车。
examples.en: Everyone started getting off only after the bus stopped.

examples.zh: 请在前面路口停下。
examples.en: Please stop at the intersection ahead.

examples.zh: 他一直在说话，根本不停下。
examples.en: He just keeps talking and doesn't stop at all.

meaning: to test; a test (of equipment, software, ability)

senses.en: to test; a test (of equipment, software, ability)

note: 测试 is technical (software, devices, tests of ability); an exam at school is 考试.

examples.zh: 这个程序还在测试，不太稳定。
examples.en: This program is still being tested and is not very stable.

examples.zh: 明天有一次英语测试，你准备好了吗？
examples.en: There's an English test tomorrow. Are you ready?

examples.zh: 请先测试网络，再开始开会。
examples.en: Please test the network first, then start the meeting.

meaning: to not care, not mind

senses.en: to not care, not mind

note: Followed by a noun or clause: 不在乎钱, 不在乎别人怎么说.

examples.zh: 他不在乎别人怎么说他。
examples.en: He doesn't care what others say about him.

examples.zh: 我不在乎贵不贵，只要质量好。
examples.en: I don't care whether it's expensive, as long as the quality is good.

examples.zh: 你真的不在乎吗？我觉得你很难过。
examples.en: Do you really not care? I think you're upset.

meaning: to breathe; breathing

senses.en: to breathe; breathing

note: 深呼吸 = deep breath; 呼吸困难 is a common medical complaint.

examples.zh: 他呼吸很困难，得马上去医院。
examples.en: He has trouble breathing and must go to the hospital at once.

examples.zh: 先深呼吸，别紧张。
examples.en: Take a deep breath first and don't be nervous.

examples.zh: 山上的空气很新鲜，呼吸起来很舒服。
examples.en: The mountain air is fresh and feels comfortable to breathe.

meaning: to be late, arrive late

senses.en: to be late, arrive late

note: For being late to work or class: 上班/上课迟到. Not for "late" in general (晚).

examples.zh: 对不起，路上堵车，我迟到了。
examples.en: Sorry, there was a traffic jam and I'm late.

examples.zh: 明天的会议很重要，千万别迟到。
examples.en: Tomorrow's meeting is important, so don't be late.

examples.zh: 你今天怎么又迟到了？
examples.en: Why are you late again today?

meaning: role, character (in a play, film, or situation)

senses.en: role, character (in a play, film, or situation)

note: Also figurative: 扮演……的角色 = play the role of.

examples.zh: 你喜欢这部电影里的哪个角色？
examples.en: Which character in this film do you like?

examples.zh: 在家里，妈妈常常是照顾大家的角色。
examples.en: At home, mom is often the one who looks after everyone.

examples.zh: 他想试一试演医生这个角色。
examples.en: He wants to try playing the role of a doctor.

meaning: to include, consist of

senses.en: to include, consist of

note: Lists the parts: 价格包括……; 包括我在内 = including me.

examples.zh: 酒店的费用包括早饭吗？
examples.en: Does the hotel price include breakfast?

examples.zh: 我们一共五个人，包括两个孩子。
examples.en: There are five of us in total, including two children.

examples.zh: 这次旅行的费用不包括机票。
examples.en: The cost of this trip doesn't include the plane ticket.

meaning: single, only one; (of a ticket) one-way; a bill or list

senses.en: single, only one; (of a ticket) one-way; a bill or list

note: Common: 单人房间 (single room), 单人床, 单手, 单身 (single, unmarried).

examples.zh: 这张床是单人的，睡不下两个人。
examples.en: This bed is for one person; two can't sleep on it.

examples.zh: 他单手抱着孩子，手里还拿着包。
examples.en: He held the child in one arm and a bag in his hand.

examples.zh: 我想订单人房间，住两天。
examples.en: I'd like to book a single room for two nights.

meaning: to throw, cast; to put in (a vote, a letter)

senses.en: to throw, cast; to put in (a vote, a letter)

note: 投票 = vote; 投篮 = shoot a basket; 投 + 简历 = send a résumé.

examples.zh: 他在篮球比赛里投进了三个球。
examples.en: He sank three shots in the basketball game.

examples.zh: 我已经投了十份简历，还没有消息。
examples.en: I've sent out ten résumés and haven't heard back.

examples.zh: 你投谁一票？
examples.en: Who did you vote for?

meaning: history

senses.en: history

note: 历史 can be the subject or the past of a person or place: 这座城市有两千年的历史.

examples.zh: 我对中国历史很有兴趣。
examples.en: I'm very interested in Chinese history.

examples.zh: 这个城市有一千多年的历史。
examples.en: This city has more than a thousand years of history.

examples.zh: 他以前是历史老师，现在在银行工作。
examples.en: He used to be a history teacher and now works at a bank.

meaning: to go through, penetrate; thoroughly (after a verb); to leak

senses.en: to go through, penetrate; thoroughly (after a verb); to leak

note: As a complement: 湿透 (soaked), 看透 (see through), 热透 (very hot).

examples.zh: 外面下雨，我的衣服全湿透了。
examples.en: It's raining outside and my clothes are soaked through.

examples.zh: 饺子要烧透了再吃。
examples.en: Cook the dumplings through before you eat them.

examples.zh: 这件事你还没想透吗？
examples.en: Haven't you thought this through yet?

meaning: handsome, smart-looking (of a man); cool

senses.en: handsome, smart-looking (of a man); cool

note: Used for men or stylish actions: 好帅！ A woman is 漂亮.

examples.zh: 你男朋友真帅！
examples.en: Your boyfriend is really handsome!

examples.zh: 他打篮球的样子很帅。
examples.en: He looks cool playing basketball.

examples.zh: 这件外套他穿起来特别帅。
examples.en: He looks especially sharp in this jacket.

meaning: free time, spare moment; empty space (kòng)

senses.en: free time, spare moment; empty space (kòng)

note: Read kòng here. 有空 = be free; 没空 = be busy; 空儿 = free time.

examples.zh: 你周末有空吗？一起吃饭吧。
examples.en: Are you free this weekend? Let's have a meal.

examples.zh: 我今天没空，下次再见吧。
examples.en: I'm not free today; let's meet next time.

examples.zh: 等你有空的时候，给我打个电话。
examples.en: When you have time, give me a call.

meaning: to hold in one's arms, hug; to hold (a baby)

senses.en: to hold in one's arms, hug; to hold (a baby)

note: 抱抱 is a friendly "give me a hug"; 抱着 = holding.

examples.zh: 妈妈抱着孩子站在门口。
examples.en: Mom stood at the door holding the child.

examples.zh: 好久不见，来，抱一抱！
examples.en: Long time no see. Come here, give me a hug!

examples.zh: 他抱着很多书走进教室。
examples.en: He walked into the classroom carrying lots of books.

meaning: on earth, exactly (in a question); after all

senses.en: on earth, exactly (in a question); after all

note: Adds force to a question: 你究竟想怎么样？ Mostly questions.

examples.zh: 你究竟想去哪儿？快决定吧。
examples.en: Where on earth do you want to go? Decide quickly.

examples.zh: 这件事究竟是谁的错？
examples.en: Whose fault is this, exactly?

examples.zh: 他究竟来不来？我们都在等。
examples.en: Is he coming or not? We're all waiting.

meaning: to lie down, recline

senses.en: to lie down, recline

note: 躺下 = lie down; 躺在床上 = lie in bed; 躺着 = lying.

examples.zh: 我头疼，想躺一会儿。
examples.en: I have a headache and want to lie down for a while.

examples.zh: 他躺在沙发上看电视。
examples.en: He is lying on the sofa watching TV.

examples.zh: 医生说你要躺几天，别乱动。
examples.en: The doctor says you need to lie down for a few days; don't move around.
